verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth has first-party MFA for application users, using TOTP authenticator apps and phone messaging, with documented enrollment, challenge and verify flows and enforcement guidance. It also has enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO for project end-users, with Okta, Google Workspace, Entra/AD and Auth0 documented. That covers the core of requiring MFA and enterprise SSO. Missing for 10: evidence of OIDC-based enterprise SSO (only SAML 2.0 is documented), detail on how MFA/SSO is mandated (enforcement is described as app-level guidance, not a platform toggle), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
